○ Not enabled yet: tap the button below and turn on SwagKeys
Applied as you type. Change it any time from the style chip on the keyboard. Passwords, e-mail, URLs and number fields are never styled.

Dictionary entries: %1$d. A listed word is replaced when you finish it (space, punctuation or enter). Press delete right after a replacement, or tap UNDO in the strip, to restore what you typed. The SWAG pill on the keyboard toggles this.

Nothing OS uses its NDot typefaces, which Nothing licenses for Nothing brand use only, so they are not bundled. SwagKeys ships Doto, an open-source (SIL OFL 1.1) dot-matrix face in the same style. If you have a font file such as NDot 57, import it here.
That file is not a usable TrueType/OpenType font
